ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, headings, and the 2px outline and hard offset shadow on emphasised cards and buttons. Also the fill of sticky headers and the solved-solution header bar

ink-muted.$description: Muted Ink — Secondary text: sub-labels, counts, helper copy. Never for question text or answer options

canvas.$description: Canvas — Page background behind the graph-paper grid

canvas-grid.$description: Grid Line — The 1px graph-paper lines drawn every 24px on the canvas. Decorative only

card.$description: Card White — Card, option, button and bottom-nav surfaces; text on action, success and ink fills

soft.$description: Soft Fill — Quiet fills inside cards: option number badges, chips, meter tracks, formula blocks

line.$description: Line — Default 2px border on cards, options, chips, meters and icon buttons

action.$description: Action Indigo — The one primary action colour: primary button fill, progress fill, active nav tab, focus outline, formula accent bar

action-dark.$description: Action Indigo Dark — Hover and pressed state of the primary action

success.$description: Correct Green — Reserved for 'correct' and 'mastered': right-answer option, correct feedback, mastery bars. Not a general accent and not the primary CTA

success-soft.$description: Correct Wash — Background of correct options, correct feedback panels and the 'what changed' step highlight

retry.$description: Not-Quite Red — Gentle 'not quite' state: the chosen option that was not right, and the feedback heading. Never paired with harsh wording

retry-soft.$description: Not-Quite Wash — Background of the chosen not-right option and the not-quite feedback panel

hint.$description: Hint Yellow — Fill of the hint note. Yellow means 'here is help', nothing else

hint-ink.$description: Hint Ink — Text and dashed outline on the hint note

star.$description: Star Gold — Stars, XP and reward accents; fill of the 'need more help?' button with ink text

strong.$description: Strong Teal — The 'strong' mastery band (75–89%), one step below mastered. Used only on mastery maps, legends and report rows; teal, not a second green, so green keeps meaning 'correct'

strong-soft.$description: Strong Wash — Background of 'strong' mastery tiles and report rows

display.$description: Headings (h1–h3), card titles, header bars and reward numbers — a rounded display face that gives the product its friendly, hand-made voice. Weights 500–700; use 600 by default. letter-spacing: 0.2px. Free Google font, loaded via next/font as --font-fredoka

body.$description: Everything else: question text, options, body copy, buttons, labels. Weight carries emphasis (600 body, 700 questions and options, 800 buttons and chips). Free Google font, loaded via next/font as --font-nunito

caption.$description: Chips, badges, difficulty tags. Smallest size allowed for anything a child must read

label.$description: Sub-labels, counts, hint and solution step text

body.$description: Default reading text and answer options (options use weight 700)

question.$description: Question text — the most important words on the screen

title.$description: Card titles, sticky header title, solved-solution header

heading.$description: Section headings ('Pick a chapter') and feedback headings ('Not quite. Let's look again')

display.$description: Page hero greeting and results headline. One per screen

8.$description: Gap between chips, and between a button's icon and label

12.$description: Gap between cards in a grid; inner gap in option rows

16.$description: Card padding and page side padding

24.$description: Gap between page sections; graph-paper grid size

48.$description: Minimum touch target height for every button

96.$description: Bottom page padding that clears the bottom nav

note.$description: Inline blocks inside a card: formula, answer strip, step highlight

tile.$description: Icon buttons, emoji tiles, stat pills

width.$description: Every outline is 2px. 1px borders are not part of the system

accent.$description: Thick coloured left edge on list cards (chapters, continue-learning)

hard-lg.$description: The hero card and the question card — at most one per screen

card.$description: Surface level 1: Cards, options, buttons, bottom nav

soft.$description: Surface level 2: Quiet fills inside a card

ink.$description: Surface level 3: Sticky header and solved-solution header bar, with white text

app.socratic.design.source: Visual language ported from the ipm-maths-practice app
